beaches.name: Mpenjati Beach (naturist section north of the lagoon mouth)
beaches.summary: Nude use is tolerated on about 300 m of shore north of the Mpenjati lagoon mouth. The KwaZulu-Natal Naturist Association describes the section as unmarked and not officially designated; the council's 2014 approval of a nudist-friendly stretch was found improperly made by the Public Protector in November 2017. The rest of the reserve beach is ordinary swimwear use.
